metadata.datasource: October 2019 pp.1/3; ID-11 stock 20 C 8 min, G .62; original PDF archived by 125px
metadata.license: CC0-1.0 (new numerical chart readings; source documents retain their copyright)
limitations: ID-11 stock, 20 C, 8 min (G .62). Relative wedge axis/source correction assumed; no red sensitivity. Grain, shoulder and base spectrum uncalibrated.
ID-11 原液 20℃ 8 分钟（G0.62）；楔形光谱轴与光源解释为假设，无红光感应。颗粒、肩部及片基光谱未标定。
metadata.reading_precision: approx. 0.05 density, 5-10 nm and 0.1 log sensitivity; not instrument measurements
metadata.tails: constant endpoints outside chart range; not measured latitude
metadata.grain: equal thirds sublayer decomposition is assumed; no stock-specific spatial grain calibration
metadata.wedge_assumption: 2850 K wedge ordinate treated as log sensitivity as drawn, without source correction; not an absolute spectral measurement. Outside plotted band sensitivity is negligible.
metadata.exposure_origin: Relative chart: one log exposure above D=base+0.1; not a recovered ISO exposure or push-process speed.
